en: Super Typhoon Yolanda in 2013 produced sustained winds of 230 kilometers per hour, making it one of the strongest tropical cyclones ever recorded.
A single strike of lightning can heat the surrounding air to 30,000 degrees Celsius, which is about five times hotter than the Sun's surface.
Diamond is the hardest known natural mineral, scoring a perfect 10 on the Mohs hardness scale, while the softest, talc, scores a 1.
Mauna Kea in Hawaii is the tallest mountain on Earth, measuring 10,211 meters from its underwater base, taller than Mount Everest's 8,848 meters.
About 97 percent of Earth's water is salty ocean water, leaving only 3 percent as freshwater, mostly frozen in ice caps.
A single handful of healthy soil can contain over one billion bacteria, which is more than the total human population on Earth.
Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system, with a diameter of 139,820 kilometers, which is more than 11 times wider than Earth.
The Sun is about 400 times larger than the Moon in diameter, but it is also exactly 400 times farther away from Earth.
Proxima Centauri is the closest star to our solar system, located about 4.24 light-years away, meaning its light takes over four years to reach Earth.
The Moon is slowly moving away from Earth at about 3.8 centimeters per year, roughly the same speed that human fingernails grow.
About 90 percent of the world's earthquakes and 75 percent of its active volcanoes occur along the Pacific Ring of Fire, including the Philippines.
In the deep ocean, a tsunami can travel as fast as a jet plane, reaching speeds up to 800 kilometers per hour.
